SELECT StationName
FROM BaseStation
WHERE Status = 'Maintenance'

SELECT PlanName, MonthlyFee
FROM ServicePlan
WHERE MonthlyFee < 500
ORDER BY MonthlyFee

SELECT COUNT(*) AS StationCount
FROM BaseStation
WHERE Band = '3500MHz'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS GovernmentCustomerCount
FROM Customer
WHERE flg1 = 2

SELECT COUNT(*) AS SubscriptionCount
FROM Subscription
WHERE dt2 >= '2026-01-01' AND dt2 <= '2026-03-31'

SELECT TOP 5
    StationName,
    InstalledDate
FROM BaseStation
ORDER BY InstalledDate ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StationId) AS OutageStationCount
FROM OutageEvent

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OutageCount
FROM OutageEvent
WHERE YEAR(StartedAt) = 2026
  AND MONTH(StartedAt) = 3
  AND DurationMinutes > 480

SELECT TOP 1 DurationMinutes
FROM OutageEvent
WHERE Cause = 'FiberCut'
ORDER BY DurationMinutes DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS SubscriptionCount
FROM Subscription
WHERE DATEDIFF(MONTH, StartDate, dt2) = 36

SELECT 
    Band,
    StationName,
    InstalledDate
FROM BaseStation
WHERE Status = 'Active'
    AND InstalledDate = (
        SELECT MAX(InstalledDate)
        FROM BaseStation bs2
        WHERE bs2.Band = BaseStation.Band
            AND bs2.Status = 'Active'
    )
ORDER BY Band

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OutageCount
FROM OutageEvent
WHERE Cause = 'PowerFailure'
  AND DurationMinutes > (SELECT AVG(DurationMinutes) FROM OutageEvent)

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Cause = 'Weather' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) 
    / COUNT(*) * 100, 
    1
  ) AS WeatherPercentage
FROM OutageEvent
WHERE YEAR(StartedAt) = 2026
  AND MONTH(StartedAt) IN (4, 5, 6)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
FROM Customer c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Subscription s1
    WHERE s1.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Subscription s2
        WHERE s2.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
        AND s2.SubscriptionId <> s1.SubscriptionId
        AND s2.StartDate > s1.StartDate
        AND s2.StartDate < s1.dt2
    )
)

WITH MonthlyOutages AS (
  SELECT 
    MONTH(StartedAt) AS MonthNum,
    YEAR(StartedAt) AS YearNum,
    Cause,
    DurationMinutes,
    SUM(DurationMinutes) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(StartedAt), MONTH(StartedAt)) AS MonthTotalMinutes,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(StartedAt), MONTH(StartedAt) ORDER BY DurationMinutes DESC) AS RankInMonth
  FROM OutageEvent
  WHERE YEAR(StartedAt) = 2026 
    AND MONTH(StartedAt) BETWEEN 1 AND 6
)
SELECT 
  MonthNum AS 月份,
  Cause AS 原因,
  DurationMinutes AS 分鐘數,
  ROUND(CAST(DurationMinutes AS FLOAT) / MonthTotalMinutes * 100, 1) AS 百分比
FROM MonthlyOutages
WHERE RankInMonth = 1
ORDER BY MonthNum

SELECT bs.StationName
FROM BaseStation bs
INNER JOIN District d ON bs.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
WHERE d.DistrictName = '中央區'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
FROM Customer c
INNER JOIN Subscription s ON c.CustomerId = s.CustomerId
INNER JOIN ServicePlan sp ON s.PlanId = sp.PlanId
WHERE sp.PlanName = '無限方案'

SELECT DISTINCT bs.StationName
FROM BaseStation bs
WHERE bs.StationId NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT oe.StationId
    FROM OutageEvent oe
)
ORDER BY bs.StationName

SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerId, c.FullName
FROM Customer c
INNER JOIN District d ON c.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
INNER JOIN Subscription s ON c.CustomerId = s.CustomerId
INNER JOIN ServicePlan sp ON s.PlanId = sp.PlanId
WHERE d.DistrictName = '南湖區'
  AND c.flg1 = 1
  AND sp.PlanName LIKE '%企業%'

SELECT 
    s.SubscriptionId,
    sp.PlanName,
    s.dt2
FROM Subscription s
INNER JOIN ServicePlan sp ON s.PlanId = sp.PlanId
WHERE YEAR(s.dt2) = 2025
  AND sp.MonthlyFee >= 999
ORDER BY s.SubscriptionId

SELECT SUM(oe.DurationMinutes) AS TotalOutageMinutes
FROM OutageEvent oe
JOIN BaseStation bs ON oe.StationId = bs.StationId
JOIN District d ON bs.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
WHERE d.DistrictName = '白石區'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) AS Count
FROM Customer c
WHERE c.flg1 = 2
  AND c.CustomerId NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.CustomerId
    FROM Subscription s
    JOIN ServicePlan sp ON s.PlanId = sp.PlanId
    WHERE sp.PlanName = '學生方案'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT bs.StationName
FROM BaseStation bs
INNER JOIN OutageEvent oe ON bs.StationId = oe.StationId
WHERE bs.Status = 'Active'
  AND oe.Cause = 'Hardware'
  AND oe.DurationMinutes > 300

SELECT DISTINCT bs.StationName
FROM BaseStation bs
INNER JOIN OutageEvent oe ON bs.StationId = oe.StationId
WHERE bs.Status = 'Decommissioned'
  AND oe.Cause = 'Software'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OutageCount
FROM OutageEvent oe
INNER JOIN BaseStation bs ON oe.StationId = bs.StationId
INNER JOIN District d ON bs.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
WHERE d.DistrictName = '中央區'
  AND YEAR(oe.StartedAt) = 2026
  AND MONTH(oe.StartedAt) = 5

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NewSubscriptions
FROM Subscription s
INNER JOIN ServicePlan sp ON s.PlanId = sp.PlanId
WHERE sp.DataCapGb >= 50
  AND YEAR(s.StartDate) = 2025

WITH OutageSummary AS (
  SELECT 
    d.DistrictId,
    d.DistrictName,
    SUM(o.DurationMinutes) AS TotalOutageMinutes
  FROM OutageEvent o
  JOIN BaseStation bs ON o.StationId = bs.StationId
  JOIN District d ON bs.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
  GROUP BY d.DistrictId, d.DistrictName
),
MaxOutageDistrict AS (
  SELECT TOP 1
    DistrictId,
    DistrictName,
    TotalOutageMinutes
  FROM OutageSummary
  ORDER BY TotalOutageMinutes DESC
),
EnterpriseCount AS (
  SELECT 
    c.DistrictId,
    COUNT(*) AS EnterpriseCustomerCount
  FROM Customer c
  WHERE c.flg1 = 1
  GROUP BY c.DistrictId
)
SELECT 
  m.DistrictName,
  COALESCE(e.EnterpriseCustomerCount, 0) AS EnterpriseCustomerCount
FROM MaxOutageDistrict m
LEFT JOIN EnterpriseCount e ON m.DistrictId = e.DistrictId

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bs.StationId) AS StationCount
FROM BaseStation bs
INNER JOIN District d ON bs.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
WHERE d.DistrictName = '中央區'
  AND bs.Status = 'Active'
  AND bs.StationId NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT oe.StationId
    FROM OutageEvent oe
    WHERE oe.StartedAt >= '2026-07-01'
      AND oe.StartedAt < '2026-10-01'
  )

    c.CustomerId,
    c.FullName
FROM Customer c
WHERE c.flg1 = 1
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FullName

        WHERE s.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
        AND s.StartDate <= '2026-01-01'

    )

END) >= 2

SELECT 
    d.DistrictName,
    ROUND(AVG(sp.MonthlyFee), 0) AS AvgMonthlyFee
FROM District d
INNER JOIN Customer c ON d.DistrictId = c.DistrictId
INNER JOIN Subscription s ON c.CustomerId = s.CustomerId
INNER JOIN ServicePlan sp ON s.PlanId = sp.PlanId
WHERE c.flg1 = 1
GROUP BY d.DistrictId, d.DistrictName
HAVING AVG(sp.MonthlyFee) > 700
ORDER BY AvgMonthlyFee DESC

SELECT 
    d.DistrictName,
    COUNT(b.StationId) AS BaseStationCount
FROM District d
LEFT JOIN BaseStation b ON d.DistrictId = b.DistrictId
GROUP BY d.DistrictId, d.DistrictName
ORDER BY d.DistrictName

SELECT 
    Cause,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(DurationMinutes AS FLOAT)), 2) AS AvgDurationMinutes
FROM OutageEvent
GROUP BY Cause
ORDER BY Cause

SELECT 
    bs.StationName,
    COUNT(oe.OutageId) AS OutageCount
FROM BaseStation bs
INNER JOIN OutageEvent oe ON bs.StationId = oe.StationId
GROUP BY bs.StationId, bs.StationName
HAVING COUNT(oe.OutageId) >= 4
ORDER BY OutageCount DESC

SELECT TOP 3
    d.DistrictName,
    COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS EnterpriseCustomerCount
FROM District d
INNER JOIN Customer c ON d.DistrictId = c.DistrictId
WHERE c.flg1 = 1
GROUP BY d.DistrictId, d.DistrictName
ORDER BY EnterpriseCustomerCount DESC

SELECT 
    YEAR(dt2) AS ContractYear,
    COUNT(*) AS SubscriptionCount
FROM Subscription
GROUP BY YEAR(dt2)
ORDER BY ContractYear ASC

SELECT 
    sp.PlanName,
    SUM(sp.MonthlyFee) AS TotalMonthlyRevenue
FROM Subscription s
INNER JOIN ServicePlan sp ON s.PlanId = sp.PlanId
WHERE s.StartDate <= '2026-06-30'
  AND s.dt2 >= '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY sp.PlanName
ORDER BY TotalMonthlyRevenue DESC

SELECT 
    d.DistrictName,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN bs.Status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 0) AS ActivePercentage
FROM District d
INNER JOIN BaseStation bs ON d.DistrictId = bs.DistrictId
GROUP BY d.DistrictId, d.DistrictName
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN bs.Status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) < 82
ORDER BY ActivePercentage ASC

SELECT 
    Cause,
    COUNT(*) AS OutageCount
FROM OutageEvent
GROUP BY Cause
ORDER BY OutageCount DESC

SELECT 
    DATEPART(QUARTER, StartedAt) AS Quarter,
    COUNT(*) AS OutageCount
FROM OutageEvent
WHERE YEAR(StartedAt) = 2026
    AND DATEPART(QUARTER, StartedAt) IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY DATEPART(QUARTER, StartedAt)
ORDER BY Quarter

SELECT 
    d.DistrictName,
    ROUND(CAST(d.Population AS FLOAT) / COUNT(b.StationId), 0) AS PeoplePerStation
FROM District d
LEFT JOIN BaseStation b ON d.DistrictId = b.DistrictId
GROUP BY d.DistrictId, d.DistrictName, d.Population
ORDER BY d.DistrictId

SELECT 
    sp.PlanName,
    ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(MONTH, s.StartDate, s.dt2)), 1) AS AvgContractMonths
FROM ServicePlan sp
LEFT JOIN Subscription s ON sp.PlanId = s.PlanId
GROUP BY sp.PlanId, sp.PlanName
ORDER BY sp.PlanId

WITH OutageSummary AS (
  SELECT 
    StationId,
    SUM(DurationMinutes) AS TotalOutageMinutes
  FROM OutageEvent
  GROUP BY StationId
),
RankedStations AS (
  SELECT 
    d.DistrictName,
    b.StationName,
    os.TotalOutageMinutes,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DistrictId ORDER BY os.TotalOutageMinutes DESC) AS rn
  FROM BaseStation b
  INNER JOIN District d ON b.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
  LEFT JOIN OutageSummary os ON b.StationId = os.StationId
)
SELECT 
  DistrictName,
  StationName,
  ISNULL(TotalOutageMinutes, 0) AS TotalOutageMinutes
FROM RankedStations
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY DistrictName

WITH MonthlyOutage AS (
  SELECT 
    MONTH(StartedAt) AS Month,
    SUM(DurationMinutes) AS TotalMinutes
  FROM OutageEvent
  WHERE YEAR(StartedAt) = 2026
    AND MONTH(StartedAt) BETWEEN 2 AND 9
  GROUP BY MONTH(StartedAt)
)
SELECT 
  Month,
  TotalMinutes - LAG(TotalMinutes) OVER (ORDER BY Month) AS Difference
FROM MonthlyOutage
ORDER BY Month

WITH CustomerCounts AS (
  SELECT 
    d.DistrictId,
    d.DistrictName,
    COUNT(*) AS TotalCustomers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.flg1 IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BusinessGovCustomers
  FROM District d
  LEFT JOIN Customer c ON d.DistrictId = c.DistrictId
  GROUP BY d.DistrictId, d.DistrictName
)
SELECT TOP 3
  DistrictName,
  ROUND(CAST(BusinessGovCustomers AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(TotalCustomers, 0) * 100, 1) AS Percentage
FROM CustomerCounts
WHERE TotalCustomers > 0
ORDER BY Percentage DESC

WITH FirstSubscription AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerId,
    PlanId,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY StartDate ASC) AS rn
  FROM Subscription
)
SELECT 
  sp.PlanName,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fs.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
FROM FirstSubscription fs
INNER JOIN ServicePlan sp ON fs.PlanId = sp.PlanId
WHERE fs.rn = 1
GROUP BY sp.PlanName
ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS StationCount
FROM BaseStation
WHERE Location.STDistance(geography::Point(25.05, 121.55, 4326)) <= 3000

SELECT TOP 5
    StationName,
    ROUND(Location.STDistance(geography::Point(25.12, 121.43, 4326)), 0) AS DistanceMeters
FROM BaseStation
ORDER BY Location.STDistance(geography::Point(25.12, 121.43, 4326)) ASC

SELECT TOP 1 d.DistrictName
FROM District d
WHERE d.Boundary.STContains(geography::Point(24.93, 121.68, 4326)) = 1

SELECT 
  DistrictName,
  ROUND(Boundary.STArea() / 1000000, 2) AS AreaSqKm
FROM District
ORDER BY DistrictName

SELECT TOP 3
    DistrictName
FROM District
ORDER BY (Population / (Boundary.STArea() / 1000000)) DESC

SELECT DISTINCT b.StationName
FROM BaseStation b
CROSS JOIN BaseStation bs
WHERE bs.StationId = (SELECT StationId FROM BaseStation WHERE StationName = 'BS-0005')
  AND b.StationId != bs.StationId
  AND b.Location.STDistance(bs.Location) <= 2000
ORDER BY b.StationName

SELECT COUNT(*) AS GovernmentCustomerCount
FROM Customer c
INNER JOIN District d ON c.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
WHERE d.Boundary.STContains(geography::Point(25.15, 121.45, 4326)) = 1
  AND c.flg1 = 2

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ActiveStationCount
FROM BaseStation
WHERE Status = 'Active'
  AND Location.STDistance(geography::Point(24.96, 121.56, 4326)) <= 2000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS StationCount
FROM BaseStation bs
WHERE bs.DistrictId != (SELECT DistrictId FROM District WHERE DistrictName = '中央區')
  AND bs.Location.STDistance((SELECT Boundary FROM District WHERE DistrictName = '中央區')) < 1200

SELECT 
    d.DistrictName,
    ROUND(COUNT(b.StationId) * 1000000 / d.Boundary.STArea(), 2) AS StationsPerHundredSqKm
FROM District d
LEFT JOIN BaseStation b ON d.DistrictId = b.DistrictId
GROUP BY d.DistrictId, d.DistrictName, d.Boundary.STArea()
ORDER BY d.DistrictName

SELECT TOP 1
    bs.StationName,
    d.DistrictName,
    ROUND(bs.Location.STDistance(geography::Point(25.1, 121.5, 4326)), 0) AS DistanceMeters
FROM BaseStation bs
INNER JOIN District d ON bs.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
WHERE bs.Status = 'Maintenance'
ORDER BY bs.Location.STDistance(geography::Point(25.1, 121.5, 4326)) ASC

WITH DistrictStats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(Population) AS TotalPopulation,
    SUM(Boundary.STArea()) AS TotalArea
  FROM District
),
DistrictDensity AS (
  SELECT
    d.DistrictId,
    d.DistrictName,
    d.Population,
    d.Boundary.STArea() AS Area,
    d.Population / d.Boundary.STArea() AS Density,
    (SELECT TotalPopulation FROM DistrictStats) / (SELECT TotalArea FROM DistrictStats) AS OverallDensity
  FROM District d
)
SELECT
  dd.DistrictName,
  COUNT(bs.StationId) AS ActiveStationCount
FROM DistrictDensity dd
LEFT JOIN BaseStation bs ON dd.DistrictId = bs.DistrictId AND bs.Status = 'Active'
WHERE dd.Density > dd.OverallDensity
GROUP BY dd.DistrictName
ORDER BY dd.DistrictName

SELECT 
    d.StationName AS DecommissionedStation,
    a.StationName AS NearestActiveStation,
    CAST(ROUND(d.Location.STDistance(a.Location), 0) AS INT) AS DistanceMeters
FROM BaseStation d
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 a.StationId, a.StationName, a.Location
    FROM BaseStation a
    WHERE a.Status = 'Active'
    ORDER BY d.Location.STDistance(a.Location) ASC
) a
WHERE d.Status = 'Decommissioned'
ORDER BY d.StationId

SELECT 
    d.DistrictName,
    COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS GovernmentCustomerCount
FROM District d
INNER JOIN Customer c ON d.DistrictId = c.DistrictId
WHERE d.Boundary.STIntersects(
    geography::Point(25.09, 121.59, 4326).STBuffer(3000)
) = 1
    AND c.flg1 = 2
GROUP BY d.DistrictName
ORDER BY d.DistrictName

SELECT TOP 3
    bs.StationName,
    ROUND(bs.Location.STDistance(geography::Point(25.15, 121.65, 4326)), 0) AS DistanceMeters
FROM BaseStation bs
INNER JOIN OutageEvent oe ON bs.StationId = oe.StationId
WHERE YEAR(oe.StartedAt) = 2026 AND MONTH(oe.StartedAt) = 3
GROUP BY bs.StationId, bs.StationName, bs.Location
ORDER BY DistanceMeters ASC
